blocks.orig: The Ngorongoro Kuhama Camp is an eco-friendly camp in the savannah, surrounded by acacia trees. Located on the eastern side of the Ngorongoro Crater, just a 15-minute drive from the crater, the camp is a convenient starting point for a trip to the famous caldera. It offers 16 tents with wooden floors that can accommodate one to three people. The traditional African-style tents come with beds, en-suite bathrooms, mosquito nets, free Wi-Fi and private verandas overlooking the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The camp serves international and African cuisine and can adapt dishes to suit special dietary needs. It is fully powered by solar energy, and next to the dining area is a lounge and bar with outlets for charging electronic devices. After dinner, a campfire is lit outside the dining tent, giving you a place to sit and reflect on your day at the crater and the sights you saw there.
blocks.html: Surrounded by acacia trees on the savannah, Ngorongoro Kuhama Camp is an eco-friendly camp. It sits on the eastern side of the Ngorongoro Crater, only a 15-minute drive away, which makes it a handy base for visiting the famous caldera. There are 16 tents with wooden floors, each sleeping one to three people. These traditional African-style tents have beds, en-suite bathrooms, mosquito nets, free Wi-Fi and private verandas looking out over the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The kitchen serves international and African dishes and can adjust meals for special dietary requirements. The camp runs entirely on solar power, and beside the dining area there is a lounge and bar with sockets for charging your devices. Once dinner is over, a campfire is lit outside the dining tent, where you can sit and look back on your day in the crater and everything you saw there.
